title: Open PLC With STM32
content:
[English was established as the common basis so that everyone in the global community can understand each other (see ST Community Terms and Conditions - STMicroelectronics Community, article 10)]

Can an STM32 microcontroller be programmed by OpenPLC? If so, how? Is there a video tutorial on YouTube?

---

apakah mikrokontroller stm32 bisa diprogram oleh open plc? jika iya, bagaimana caranya? apakah ada video tutorialnya di youtube?

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome ​@galang, to the community!

If you look at the requirements of Open PLC on its homepage or Github site, you will find that at least an MPU is necessary, typically also a large operating system such as Linux. This means MCUs are completely ruled out as devices capable of doing this. Only the MPU family STM32MP1 or STM32MP2 could be able to do it. The Open PLC team can provide you with further details.

Hope that helps?

Good luck!
/Peter
